name: Number Input
description: A numeric field with stepper buttons and min/max clamping.

anatomy.description: The numeric text field that re-clamps to the bounds on blur.
Increment and decrement buttons that step the value and disable at min and max.

dos: Set min and max so clamping matches the business rule.
Choose a step that matches how people think, like 5 for story points.
Treat an empty field as undefined in the caller, not as zero.
donts: Don't use it for identifiers like codes or phone numbers; use Input.
Don't use it when the value needs currency formatting; use CurrencyInput.
Don't hide the bounds; state them in the description.

examples.title: Steppers and bounds
examples.description: Steppers disable at the bounds; typing re-clamps on blur.

examples.title: Custom step
examples.description: A step of 5 with 0–100 bounds for story-point entry.

guidance.useWhen: A numeric value benefits from quick stepping.
guidance.avoidWhen: The value is an identifier, not a quantity; use Input.
guidance.behavior: Steppers use 24px touch targets and blur clamps to min/max; empty means undefined.
guidance.responsive: The field fills its container; constrain it in the form layout.

keyboard.action: Moves focus through the field and the stepper buttons.
Activates the focused stepper to increment or decrement.
Edits the value directly; the field re-clamps on blur.

notes: Steppers are labeled Increment and Decrement and disable at the min and max bounds.
An empty field reports undefined rather than zero.
Inside a Field, descriptions and errors link through aria-describedby and aria-invalid.
